name: ZeroTetris
aliases: Spacial Feature Similarity-based Sparse MLP Engine
Sparse MLP Engine for Neural Volume Rendering
definition: A hardware accelerator for Neural Volume Rendering (NVR) that leverages spatial feature similarity between adjacent sampling points to identify and bypass computation of zero activations in Multilayer Perceptrons (MLPs), enhancing energy efficiency.
summary: ZeroTetris is a hardware accelerator for neural volume rendering that exploits spatial feature similarity to bypass zero activations in MLPs, enhancing energy efficiency through row-level sparsity skipping.
